Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple, poorly marginated nodular opacities distributed peripherally in both lung fields. This pattern is characteristic of septic pulmonary emboli, which typically arise from right-sided infective endocarditis (often involving the tricuspid valve) in patients with a history of intravenous drug use.
